title: Tano Tijerina thanks supporters after District 28 loss, says he is not going anywhere
excerpt: Webb County Judge Tano Tijerina thanked supporters and said he respected voters' decision after losing the Texas Congressional District 28 race to incumbent Rep. Henry Cuellar, according to KGNS.
content:
Webb County Judge Tano Tijerina has responded to his loss in the race for Texas Congressional District 28, thanking his supporters and saying he respected the voters' decision, according to KGNS.

Incumbent Rep. Henry Cuellar won the race with 65.77 percent of the vote, according to KGNS. Tijerina received 29.63 percent, and Green Party candidate Marlon Duarn received 4.6 percent.

In a statement reported by KGNS, Tijerina said he ran because he loves South Texas and believes the region deserves better, and that his campaign was about the people of South Texas rather than Washington, outside groups, or maps.

He also said border security, safe communities, good jobs, and honest leadership remain worth fighting for, and that he still believes in the region's people and its future, according to KGNS.

The KGNS report named no specific next campaign, office, or dated action for Tijerina, beyond his general statement that he is not going anywhere.

Sources:

  • KGNS, "Tijerina provides statement, thanks supporters after defeat in District 28 race," November 4, 2026
